## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend lint and relevant tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint, tests, and build pass
- [ ] New behavior has test coverage
- [ ] No secrets, private data, recordings, datasets, model weights, or FIRST manuals are included
- [ ] Configuration and documentation are updated where needed

## Risk

Call out migrations, security boundaries, compatibility changes, and anything that needs deployment coordination.
